about: AION 2 (Global) equipment items for AionDex gear comparison.

credit.text: Item data: Aion2Data (aion2data.com), read from the AION 2 global client
credit.itemPage: https://aion2data.com/items/{id}-{slug}  (slug = name lower-cased, apostrophes removed, other non [a-z0-9] runs -> "-")
credit.terms: Unofficial fan reference. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by NCSOFT. AION is a trademark of NCSOFT Corporation; game data and art belong to it. Free to read and quote with a link to the page the number came from.

notes.ids: item ids of identical copies (same name, grade, levels, faction and stats)
notes.class: items.json has no class field. Weapons: only the class in class_of_category (derived from 759 players in the captures). Guard, armor and accessories: any class.
notes.excluded: Fist and Arcana categories, level-1 starter gear (ids 15xxxxxxx/25xxxxxxx)
